name: Saraswati Vidya Yojana: Reimbursement of Fees for Diploma/Graduation and Post-Graduation Professional Courses - DNH&DD
state: Dadra & Nagar Haveli And Daman & Diu
benefit:
**Full Reimbursement for Low Income:**

  - 100% of tuition and academic fees will be reimbursed to girl students whose parental or husband&#39;s income is below ₹2,50,000/-.

**Partial Reimbursement for Higher Income:**

  - 50% of tuition and academic fees will be reimbursed to girl students whose parental or husband&#39;s income is above ₹2,50,000/-.

**Maximum Reimbursement Limits:**

all.value: Dadra & Nagar Haveli And Daman & Diu

_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant should be a girl student. 1. Father /Husband/ Guardian/ Mother (widow/ divorced) of the girl student should be a domicile resident of UT of Dadra & Nagar Haveli and Daman & Diu. 1. Students should have studied Std. 8th to Std. 12th in any of the schools of the UT. In case the student has pursued Diploma after SSC/10th, the student should have studied Std. 6th to Std. 10th in any of the schools of the UT. 1. Only the first two daughters of a family are eligible for benefits under this scheme.
